description: Get MAPLED.md — the guide Mapled writes for the next agent and for people: the project and how the site reads it (and whether open tabs follow a publish, as the manifest's capabilities say), the content model, where the site renders each field, the last setup run, the working rules and the verification commands, rendered from the project as it is now. Write `markdown` to MAPLED.md at the repository root and commit it. If the file exists, replace everything above its `<!-- mapled:notes -->` line and keep what is below — that part belongs to the repository. Its first line is a stamp with the schema hash, the manifest version and the integration hash. Refresh it after every schema or manifest change and at the end of a setup, after report_setup or verify_setup; `npx @mapled/cli md pull` does the same from the repository and `mapled doctor` says when it is out of date. It never contains a secret — don't add one.
name: get_mapled_md
